prOriginal.nota: calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy. Found via head branch fix/add-retry-count-workflow-reminder; PR head c790227e equals the benchmark head, merged as 2dae0bfb8. On 2026-04-15 PR #28903 'refactor: Cal.diy' removed packages/features/ee (all workflow code) from the default branch.

sms-workflow-reminder-retry-count-tracki.reason: Both failure updates still wrote retryCount: reminder.retryCount + 1 from the findMany snapshot (no { increment: 1 }) in the last version before removal (scheduleSMSReminders.ts at 353f71bdc69, 2026-03-16). No change targeted it; the file was removed with all of packages/features/ee by #28903 on 2026-04-15.

The deleteMany with the unscoped { retryCount: { gt: 1 } } OR arm stayed unchanged until #21906 ('Preserve past SMS workflow reminders by disabling deletion') removed the whole deleteMany block. No retryCount-based deletion exists afterwards (main at 2025-11 only filters retryCount < 3 in findMany). The removal served row retention, not the missing method filter.

The prisma.workflowReminder.update inside the catch block remained unguarded inside the for loop through the last version before removal (353f71bdc69, 2026-03-16), so its rejection still escaped the loop. The file was removed by #28903 on 2026-04-15 without a targeting change.

The harm described, deleting pending reminders once transient errors pushed retryCount past 1, depended on the deleteMany retryCount>1 arm, which #21906 removed on 2025-06-24 for row retention. Errors still increment retryCount and #22251 (2025-07-03) later stops retrying after 3 failures, but that is a different abandonment mechanism, not the deletion of the queue.

astra.pergunta: Deletion block (incl. retryCount>1 arm) removed by #21906 on 2025-06-24; #22251 later added retryCount<3 to the findMany, so reminders failing 3 times are skipped forever but not deleted. Is #06/#e2b-01 descontinuado at 2025-06-24 or did it survive until the 2026-04-15 removal?
astra.resposta: Both descontinuado at 2025-06-24 (#21906): the destructive mechanism as written (deleting reminders once the count exhausted) was removed for an unrelated retention purpose. Counting locks/transient errors as failures remained, and #22251 introduced a different abandonment path (skip after 3 failures), a related but separate defect.

sms-workflow-reminder-retry-count-tracki.reason: twilioProvider still returns undefined when SMS sending is locked and the cron still increments retryCount on a falsy result, but the retryCount>1 deletion that permanently removed those future reminders was removed by #21906 on 2025-06-24. The later retry cap (#22251, retryCount < 3) skips them instead of deleting them, a separate behaviour.
